description: This file contains the implementation of the ActivateDeactivateWatcherGrain class, which tracks activation and deactivation calls, logs actions, and provides methods to retrieve and clear call records within an Orleans grains project.

classes.name: ActivateDeactivateWatcherGrain
classes.description: A class implementing IActivateDeactivateWatcherGrain, managing activation/deactivation call logs and integrating with Microsoft's logging framework.

methods.name: GetActivateCalls
methods.description: Returns an array of recorded activation calls.

methods.name: GetDeactivateCalls
methods.description: Returns an array of recorded deactivation calls.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all recorded activation and deactivation calls.

methods.name: RecordActivateCall
methods.description: Records an activation call with the provided activation string.

methods.name: RecordDeactivateCall
methods.description: Records a deactivation call with the provided activation string.
